row.notes: Binds the MyTeam/R&D department specialist panel: releases old holders (+0x38..+0x118, bound flag +0x138), then creates VM nodes spec_title (+0x60), spec_desc (+0x80), spec_level (+0xa0), a progress float (+0xc0), spec_current_progress_numerical (+0xe0), is_spec_available (+0x100) and a perk list (+0x118). Looks the spec up with FUN_1412dcf10(component 0x146065e50, specId); spec record: +0x02 available, +0x10 -> {level, xp, firstPerk, lastPerk, +0x18 xp-per-level table}, +0x88 icon, +0x90 title, +0x98 desc. Progress = xp / table[level]; text built with AMOUNT/TOTAL tokens. Per perk it adds description, active_text, bg_tex, show; locked perks get lng_perk_unlocked_at_level, unlocked ones "#overrides.specialists.goals.perks.%s" (name table 0x14571db68, 6 entries). Good place to read specialist level/xp layout.
